resources.string: Redirect fluid-cloud web links to the browser of your choice
Fluid cloud cards keep the system default behavior
LSPosed service not detected. Please check: 1) the module is enabled in LSPosed; 2) scope includes "Smart Decision Service"; 3) reboot the phone and retry.
Add "Smart Decision Service (com.oplus.metis)" to the module scope
Scope approved. Reboot the phone or force-stop the Smart Decision Service to apply.
The selected browser was uninstalled, please pick again
Once selected, fluid cloud cards are sent to that browser. "Disable redirect" keeps the system default.
For share-code cards: the code carries no URL, so the fluid cloud already decided which app to open. Swap that app for the one you want here.
When a swap matches, change the card\'s "Install / Go install" to "Open <target app>"
heytapbrowser://webpage?url= links, open the real URL
Cards detected as web search intent (textType 29)
http(s) web cards hardcoded to the OPPO browser
Also redirect web cards targeting other browsers; may catch directed cards
Log monitor hook and every redirect hit to the LSPosed log
View logs: LSPosed manager → Logs, filter "FluidRedirect"
Rewrites the jump target at the fluid-cloud card execution layer. Settings apply instantly — no need to restart the Smart Decision Service.
Web cards: pick a browser above and the card is sent there instead.
Share codes: copy a Quark share code elsewhere, tap the card in the fluid cloud, then set com.quark.browser → com.quark.clouddrive under App swap to open Quark Drive.
No config change needed after uninstalling the original app: when the card turns into an "install" prompt, it is still routed to the swap target instead of the app store.
After installing or updating, stop com.oplus.metis once (or reboot) so the hooks load.
Card text saved — copy the share code again to see it
